model.symmetry: Front and side projections are identical by construction.

finding: The supplied perspective photographs visually suggest a taller/narrower envelope than the current normalized blockout. This is a qualitative observation only; no numeric reference-image height/width ratio has been measured.
correction: Earlier values calculated from crop-window dimensions were crop aspect ratios, not balloon silhouette measurements. They are superseded and must not be used as geometry metrics.
limitations: Perspective, camera pitch, inflation state, ground support, occlusion, lens distortion and crop affect apparent silhouette.
The references are not a calibrated overlapping photogrammetry set.
No physical width, depth, or reference-image height/width ratio is inferred.
This review does not authorize mesh changes.
decision: Preserve Geometry v1 unchanged. Obtain calibrated front/side captures and independent measurements before proposing Geometry v2.
